title: Anxiety & Depression
cardText: For those living under a weight that won't lift or a mind that won't quiet down.
whatThisFeelsLike: [DRAFT — Matthew to rewrite in his own words] Getting through the day takes everything you have, and everyone keeps telling you to just relax or cheer up — as if you hadn't thought of that.
howWeWork: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is the backbone here: identifying the thought patterns that feed anxiety and depression and practicing concrete, evidence-based ways to change your relationship with them. This is practical work with skills you take home, paced to where you are — not a lecture about positive thinking. Available in person in West Chester or by telehealth anywhere in Ohio.
